subject: Re: October statement
body: Hi Falcon team, we have your statement. Our payment run is after the 15th of November, we will pay FT-S-0012 and FT-S-0080 after the 15th.

subject: Damaged linen delivery FT-S-0066
body: Dear Falcon, 20 cartons of linen on FT-S-0066 arrived water damaged (photos attached, delivered 6 Oct). We are withholding AED 12,000 of that invoice until a credit note is agreed. The rest will be paid on terms.
Loaded and delivered Marina Hypermarket order MH-2210 today 31 Oct 5pm, DN-5521 signed. Sales will raise the invoice on 3 Nov, value AED 42,000 before VAT.

subject: ERP licence renewal
body: FYI the annual ERP licence was paid on invoice PI-0001 from Horizon Office Supplies, AED 18,000 net. It covers 1 Nov 2026 to 31 Oct 2027.
Sent you AED 18,500 today for the urgent order DR-77 your driver delivered on 29 Oct. Please send the invoice, we need it for our VAT.

subject: Overdue balance
body: Cash is tight this month. We will clear the AED 40,000 overdue in two parts, AED 20,000 on 20 Nov and AED 20,000 on 10 Dec.

subject: Advance notice: price review
body: Copper has stayed above USD 9,000 for most of October. Under clause 4 we expect to apply the 3% increase from 1 December 2026. Formal notice to follow by 15 November.

subject: Remittance
body: Payment for all September invoices sent today. Thank you as always.
Can you resend the invoice copy for last week? Will pay this Thursday.

subject: Next quarter volumes
body: We plan to increase orders by about 15% from December. Please confirm stock of ceramic dinner sets.

subject: October invoices
body: Please find our October invoices. Note our new price list of AED 12.50 per kg applies from October.

subject: Fuel surcharge
body: Fuel surcharge stays at current rate for November.
Our bank details are unchanged. Ignore any email asking you to change them.

subject: Payment plan
body: For the older balance of AED 52,000 we propose AED 26,000 in mid November and the rest in mid December.

subject: Payment
body: All October invoices are approved and scheduled on normal terms.
